facts.fact: 她先醒：翅膀在睡梦里自己缠住了 Dante——一扇被夹在墙与BODY之间（他手指一直垫在翼膜最敏感处）、一扇绕着他的肩臂；「Maybe I had missed physical contact more than I realized」——她缺肢体接触缺了太久。
facts.anchor: My wings had curled around Dante, one of them sandwiched between him and the wall so tightly that it would've been painful if he hadn't wedged his fingers under the most sensitive part of it.

facts.fact: 喂血的即时变化：他的眼睛从深暗变成巧克力色＋金斑，「more alive / Healthier」——这是她的血做成的；「I had done something good, for the first time in so long. My chest ached. My fucking soul ached.」——做好事的灼痛感（堕落者的救赎渴望首现）。
facts.anchor: There were golden flecks through his irises that definitely hadn't been there before he fed from me.

facts.fact: pixie 前史：几十年前交往几个月；领导层的未婚恶魔被视为不稳定，所以他一直在找 mate——未果；那位 pixie 从不信任他到肯展翅，他也并不想看。
facts.anchor: We were only together for a few months, a few decades ago. Unmated demons in leadership positions are seen as unstable, so I was always trying to find a mate.

facts.fact: 相亲总失败的真因：他 agreeable 但对永恒婚约会 bored；他被打过招呼「无聊不是恋爱里合理的感受」；她反驳「I disagree, but I'm a fallen angel. I don't think my opinions on the topic are healthy.」——被追问堕落与爱情观的关系，只答「More than you'd think」（钩子）。
facts.anchor: There's just a big difference between being agreeable and being interested in being mated to someone for the rest of my immortality. It's a big commitment. I get… bored.

facts.fact: 警报规则：门十分钟后开、只开一分钟——她当年没设计好转换时间，自嘲又添一条「我把复杂魔法搞砸」的清单；十分钟的仓促促成快速解决＋再喂血。
facts.anchor: It buzzes to let us know that the doors will open in ten minutes. They're only open for one minute. The prison doesn't give us much time for transitions.

facts.fact: 委托人揭晓：fae 女王 Merrily Fall（Grayson 的 mate）才是请她来的人——「incubus king 单独上门我根本不会开门」；Dante 惊呼 Grayson 爱了她一个世纪，她证实 They're soulmates、灵气亮到 blinding；她自曝几乎没睡过——自 Merrily 告知她把 Dante 和 Jazz 关进来那天起。
facts.anchor: She's mated to Grayson Darke, and she's the one who asked me to come in here. No offense, but I wouldn't have answered the door if the incubus king had shown up alone.

facts.fact: 能力设定：她能看见灵气——一些天使可以，Shiv 不能；这解释了她一路以灵气辨人（ch01 三色灵气）的感知系统。
facts.anchor: Yeah. Some angels can. Riv—Shiv—can't, though.

facts.fact: 收尾张力：他说「就算永远困在这里，我也为 Gray 高兴」，她说「Don't curse us」；踏出走廊时百万道目光落在他们身上——她只祈祷其中没有一双属于 River。
facts.anchor: Don't curse us," I murmured, as he stepped out of the hallway. I could feel a million eyes on us, and all I could do was hope that none of them belonged to River.
